provenance.source_evidence: EPITENG.HLP and EPITFRA.HLP document the measure and test families, not these captured numeric outputs.
provenance.reproduction: Recompute the equations documented per case below; run pytest to compare the implementation with these independent arithmetic references.
provenance.warning: These are not EpiTable 6.04 outputs and must not be described as legacy goldens.

cases.name: standard
cases.provenance: Formula arithmetic: OR=(a*d)/(b*c); RR=(a/(a+b))/(c/(c+d)); RD=Re-Ru; AF_e=RD/Re; PAF=(Rpop-Ru)/Rpop.

cases.name: small_counts
cases.provenance: Same equations as standard case, with exact integer margins and fractions evaluated independently.

cases.name: zero_cell
cases.provenance: Same risk equations; OR numerator is zero and no continuity correction is applied. PAF uses the direct population-risk definition, not a formula that divides by RR.

expected_provenance.attributable_fraction_exposed: Undefined because exposed risk is zero and RD/Re divides by zero.
